title: BCECE Mop-Up Revised Counselling Schedule 2025
organization: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board
postName: BCECE Mop-Up Round – Revised Counselling Schedule
vacancyDetails: Revised schedule for mop-up counselling against vacant seats after main rounds
qualification: BCECE qualified candidates eligible for remaining seats as per mop-up rules
selectionProcess: Willingness / registration → Mop-up allotment → Document verification → Admission
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
2. Open Mop-Up revised counselling schedule PDF
3. Submit willingness if required
4. Check allotment on counselling portal
5. Report to college with documents within dates
shortDescription: BCECE Mop-Up Revised Counselling Schedule – check vacant seat allotment dates on bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
content:
BCECEB publishes mop-up counselling schedules for leftover seats after regular allotment rounds of BCECE / related courses.

Candidates must follow the revised schedule only from the official board website, complete willingness/registration if asked, and report for document verification on time or risk seat cancellation.
